p: iron pan: Which signified the stubbornness and hardness of their hearts.
house of Israel upon it: By this he represented the idolatry and sin of the ten tribes (for Samaria was on his left hand from Babylon) and how they had remained in it three hundred and ninety years.
right side: Which declared Judah, who had now from the time of Josiah slept in their sins forty years.
arm shall be uncovered: In token of a speedy vengeance.
cords upon thee: The people would so straightly be besieged that they would not be able to turn them.
and spelt: Meaning that the famine would be so great that they would be glad to eat whatever they could get.
three hundred and ninety days shalt: Which were fourteen months that the city was besieged and this was as many days as Israel sinned years.
twenty shekels a day: Which make a pound.
with dung that cometh out of: Signifying by this the great scarcity of fuel and matter to burn.
abominable flesh come into my mouth: Much less such vile corruption.
dung for man's dung: To be as fire to bake your bread with.
the staff of bread in Jerusalem: That is, the force and strength with which it would nourish, Isa 3:1, Eze 14:13.
